name: Worm
text: Most bottom fish take a worm.

name: Shrimp
text: Bream, wrasse and scorpionfish love shrimp.

name: Bread
text: Mullet and small shoal fish nibble bread.

name: Squid
text: Morays and congers come out for squid.

name: Sardine strip
text: Cut from netted sardines; mackerel and traps.

name: Live sardine
text: Kept alive in the well; the big hunters take nothing else.

name: Oyster
text: From the Lucrine traps; a golden fish is said to love them.
